confidence_notes: Restaurant, beer and coffee anchors rest on several crowd-sourced and aggregated cost-of-living sources that agree roughly and are dated mid-2026 or 2023, so they are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass have no direct price evidence and are set from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2x beer, wine about 1.3x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no accommodation searches or live listings were checked. Resort-area bar and hotel pricing can run well above these figures, and July is peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Treated as a Red Sea resort town on the Sinai Peninsula, priced at a premium over Egyptian national averages and similar to other Egyptian Red Sea resort towns (for example Hurghada). Food and drink anchors follow aggregated 2026 estimates for Sharm El Sheikh, and accommodation follows a resort-town tourist premium.
